subject: [PATCH 17/60] PM: hibernate: size the image from common memory

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series aims to improve the hibernation image sizing by only counting free pages in zones on N_MEMORY_COMMON nodes, as image pages can only come from common memory. The patch modifies functions such as `hibernate_preallocate_memory`, `count_free_highmem_pages`, and `enough_free_mem` to filter out non-common memory zones.
